Root cause: sync-over-async deadlock. After StartWithClassicDesktopLifetime returns, Avalonia's SynchronizationContext is still installed on the main thread; host.StopAsync().GetResult() blocked it, and StopAsync's await-continuation was posted back to that blocked thread -> hang (only kill -9 worked). Fix: run host.StopAsync via Task.Run (detached from the UI context) in Program.cs; root PosixSignalRegistrations with 'using'; ConfigureAwait(false) in HelperLifecycle.StopAsync. Verified: SIGTERM exits in ~1s with graceful cleanup (helper killed, no orphan).

Process supervision + update/restart orchestration. RoleProcessSupervisor (monitor-loop policy mirroring HelperLifecycle, injectable IRoleProcess + poll delay): ordered startup (shell-core owner before UI clients), per-child crash-restart with tick-based backoff, RestartAllAsync (kill+respawn all → each re-execs the CURRENT binary = latest build), RestartCoreAsync (swap core, UIs stay up = update-on-demand), StopAsync. Launcher control channel over the shell-core UDS transport (LauncherControl: taskbar->launcher Quit/RestartAll/RestartCore, since .NET can't receive SIGUSR1/2); App.RequestExit/RequestRestart now fan out to the launcher when supervised, else in-process. --role=launcher entry (RunLauncher) spawns core+taskbar, hands children the shared shell-core + control endpoints via env, parks on SIGTERM. Deadlock-avoidance: all locks launcher-local, kills one-directional. 6 RoleProcessSupervisorTests (ordered start, crash-respawn, RestartAll, RestartCore-only, Stop-halts-loop, keeps-retrying-failing-child). LIVE smoke (--pal=fake) proved: launcher spawns core+taskbar in order; killing core → supervisor respawns fresh PID; SIGTERM launcher reaps all children cleanly. Fixed a real SIGTERM bug found live — handlers now set ctx.Cancel=true so teardown runs before .NET terminates (also applied to RunShellCore, preventing an orphaned helper). ShellModel.LoadWindowIcon now dedupes window-icon PNG decode via an FNV-1a64 content-hash ConcurrentDictionary<long,Bitmap>: N windows of an app decode once and share one immutable bitmap.
